bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (share sheet to installed apps), springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLRequest, URLSession), springboard/sdk/src/social.rs and springboard/sdk/src/social_account.rs (service requests, accounts, signing); no social-network service
summary: Apple's Social framework composes a post to a social network and signs HTTP requests with the user's social account. BifrOSt has a share sheet that passes text, URLs and files to installed apps, a generic HTTP client, a service request model with multipart bodies, a draft that becomes a POST, and an account store with OAuth 1.0a and bearer signing. Nothing signs in an account or posts to a network yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/compose.rs (ComposeSheet, ComposeSheet::with_draft), springboard/sdk/src/social.rs (draft_request); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-20.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/compose_sheet.rs, springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (Compose Post target)
features.note: A sheet starts from a draft (such as the items shared into it) and refuses changes once presented, tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-20.rs; draft_request turns a sent draft into a form POST (host unit tests in social.rs). Gap: no editor lets the user type or attach items, which needs shell text input and a Midget check.

features.note: Headless tests (headless_share_sheet_* in sdk/tests) and host unit tests: services are built from the same rules the shell's menu uses, canPerform checks each item kind, and a share_done answer reaches did_choose and did_share_items or did_fail_to_share_items. Copy performs through the clipboard. No image property, and perform for an app or Compose Post goes through the menu because the shell has no message for one named target. Parity needs a Midget check of the menu.

Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (social.rs, accounts.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. No account store and no OAuth or token signing. BifrOSt Cloud accounts live in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, outside this repo. Built 2026-10-17: OAuth 2 token model (springboard/sdk/src/social_oauth2.rs: from_response, needs_refresh, refresh_request, sign); tests social_oauth2::tests. Bearer and OAuth 1.0a signing are unchanged.

features.feature: Receiving shared content in an extension
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (manifest handles and schemes; Input::Open; App::document); tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs
features.note: Inbound request flags, text carried as data URLs, and handles matched by type and scheme are tested headless (headless_share_sheet_inbound_*, headless_share_sheet_text_travels_*, headless_share_sheet_files_* in sdk/tests). An app can receive shared URLs, text and files. There is no separate extension process.
Named third-party networks, several of them defunct. Tied to Apple's service list, not to a desktop capability.

gaps: No compose sheet in the shell that edits a draft and posts it through draft_request (SLComposeViewController equivalent).
No sign-in flow or account provider: accounts can be modelled and signed, but the user cannot add one from the shell (SLRequest.account equivalent).
OAuth 2 tokens are read, refreshed and used for bearer signing (social_oauth2); the sign-in flow that obtains the first token is not in the shell.

The share services have no image property and perform(withItems:) reaches only Copy; an app or Compose Post is performed through the menu, because the shell has no message for one named target (see docs/bifrost-ui.md, 'Share sheet' gaps).
